claims.note: F3: the reason half (heterogeneity and countries with different cost structures) is addressed and matches. Heterogeneity is also stated in the limitations: «the included studies demonstrated substantial heterogeneity». The instruction half («باید با احتیاط تفسیر کرد») is not stated as advice by the source, so it is silent (NOT_IN_SOURCE) and does not decide the verdict. «تعداد مطالعات کم» has no matching quantifier in the source, which reports five studies; this is noted as unaddressed.

The instruction half is judged by F2-iii way 2: it agrees with the reported effect that inexperienced operators «may require additional sessions for adjustments». The source also reports that operator experience «did not markedly influence total costs»; this is named here but does not override the faithful sentence (F2-v step 3).

source_conclusion: There- fore, workflow selection should be guided by clinical feasibility, clinician and dental technician experience, and resource availability rather than assumptions of superior cost-efficiency.
